description: Create a recurring coding task that the AI runs automatically on a cron schedule (e.g. a weekly SEO pass). Use for 'every Monday, do X to my repo' requests.

cron.description: Cron expression, e.g. '0 9 * * 1' for every Monday at 9am UTC

repo.description: Repo of one of the user's deployed VibeKit projects, as 'owner/repo' (the repo vibekit_submit_task made). That project's agent runs each time and posts its report in the project chat.

task.description: What to do on each run, e.g. 'Improve SEO and page speed'

name: vibekit_create_schedule

outputSchema.description: Result envelope: ok=true with data on success, ok=false with error on failure.

data.description: The created schedule: id, name, and cron expression.

error.description: Error message when ok is false (e.g. missing/invalid VIBEKIT_API_KEY, or an API error).

title: VibeKit Create Schedule
